subject: renderUI vs. update(Widget) - why choose one or the other?

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: renderUI vs. update(Widget) - why choose one or the other?
parts:
Hello,
 I have been doing some shiny coding where I need to have an input widget - say a selectizeInput for example, update based on other choices a user makes. For example one selecitzeInput could let the user choose a country and based on that a second one would let the user pick from a list of cities in the county. When I do this sort of thing I use renderUI to make the second input, and it gets its list of choices reactively based on the first input. However, it seems like I could accomplish the same thing using updateSelectizeInput.  Is there any reason I should choose the update method over the renderUI method? Is there any situation where the update method is preferred?

Thanks ,
JP
